import json, subprocess, sys
BASE = {"epoch": 7, "node_count": 4,
        "edges": [{"tail": 0, "head": 1, "capacity": 4}],
        "commodities": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "demand": 2,
                         "paths": [[0]], "previous": [16]}],
        "failed_edges": [], "budget": 1}
payload = json.dumps(BASE).encode()
LIMIT = 4*1024*1024
def mk(content_len, nl):
    pad = content_len - len(payload)
    assert pad >= 0
    return payload + b" "*pad + (b"\n" if nl else b"")
cases = [("content %d + newline (=total %d)"%(LIMIT-1, LIMIT), mk(LIMIT-1, True), "ok"),
         ("content %d + newline (=total %d)"%(LIMIT, LIMIT+1), mk(LIMIT, True), "bad"),
         ("content %d no newline"%LIMIT, mk(LIMIT, False), "ok"),
         ("content %d no newline"%(LIMIT+1), mk(LIMIT+1, False), "bad"),
         ("content %d no newline"%(LIMIT+5), mk(LIMIT+5, False), "bad"),
         ("content %d + newline (=total %d)"%(LIMIT-2, LIMIT-1), mk(LIMIT-2, True), "ok")]
for name, raw, exp in cases:
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'], input=raw, capture_output=True, timeout=300)
    st = json.loads(p.stdout.decode().splitlines()[0]).get("status")
    ok = (st != "invalid") if exp=="ok" else (st == "invalid")
    print("%-45s %-10s %s" % (name, st, "PASS" if ok else "FAIL"))
PYEOF
